title: Chapter 793
paragraphs: Chapter 793
Episode 196. The Big Snake, Ameris (2)
When Jin suddenly bowed his head in respect, Ameris seemed momentarily taken aback and coughed awkwardly. Hedo also bowed his head to Ameris following Jin.
[Hmm, I see. My eyes didn't deceive me. You're not entirely terrible beings.]
"I'll formally introduce myself again. I am Jin Runcandel, the leader of the Vamel Federation and the steward of the 59th Runcandel estate."
"I'm part of the Vamel Federation... an executive? Jin, am I an executive?"
"If Sir Hedo isn't an executive, then who is?"
"That's true. What's the precise title?"
"Well, let's say Chief of Staff."
"That works. I am Hedo, the Chief of Staff of the Vamel Federation and the butler serving Miss Sandra. As I mentioned before, I don't have a surname."
Ameris smiled at the two men as if she found them amusing.
[Sandra, you must be referring to one of the children outside the pit. There's a rather eccentric child and a calm child. Which one are you referring to? It can't be the cat, right?]
She was aware of the existence of Valeria's group, who were settled about ten miles away.
"The former."
[You must have had a tough time. But it's probably thanks to that child that you didn't become corrupt despite having such power.]
Hedo didn't fully understand the meaning of her words, but he just nodded in response.
A brief silence ensued. Ameris appeared to be deep in thought, sifting through her faintly resurfacing memories.

[...Then I suppose I should tell you who I am. It took me a moment to recall my memories. I am Ameris, an immortal born with a tragic destiny. When I was awake, mortals used to call me the Great Snake.]
"So, you're not a dragon."
[I'm not entirely unrelated to dragons. They would be like my distant descendants.]
"...Did you say distant descendants?"
No one knew exactly when the dragons had first appeared in the world. Even the dragons themselves didn't know their origins. They only knew that they were 'crafted by their respective gods.'
If Ameris's words were true, Jin and Hedo had just learned one of the world's long-standing secrets.

[Now that we have introduced each other, I have a question. You mentioned that you are trying to prevent the resurrection of the Sun God. Why then did you venture into the underground world I protect?]

"At present, there's a bizarre group called the Solaris Cult wreaking havoc. We're at odds with them and recently acquired information that a gateway to the demon world might exist here. May I explain the situation that our world is currently facing?"
[Go ahead.]
For a while, Jin explained the state of the world to Ameris.

He talked about the 'monsters' that started to appear from the Imperial Palace of the Black Emperor. He continued with the birth of the abominable deity after Gleeick's disappearance, and the suspected involvement of the Solaris Cult behind these incidents. Naturally, the discussion also included the structure of the giant powers.
While Ameris was listening attentively to Jin's story, she occasionally groaned, experiencing severe headaches. It was a headache caused by her memories resurfacing and sinking in a chaotic mix.

"...So, our excavation was solely for confirmation purposes. Since there's so little information about the Sun God, I thought knowing something would allow us to respond more flexibly to our enemies. Honestly, I had no expectations, but here we are meeting you, Ameris."
When the explanation was over, Ameris slowly nodded her head.
[I see... I more or less understand your situation. It's not as I remembered it before I fell asleep, but the surface world seems quite chaotic.]
"When exactly did you fall asleep?"

[I don't remember the exact time. But you mentioned that it's now the year 1803, and the Myoung Clan, who made significant contributions to defeating the abominable deity, disappeared half a million years ago. Solderet barely managed to seal and save 77 people.]
"That's correct."
[It's clear that the time when I fell asleep was much earlier than half a million years ago. I fought and fell asleep when I received the fate of boundary guarding when this world was split in half.]
The 'fate of boundary guarding' that Ameris talked about wasn't just about blocking those who seek the underground world.
Her fate was to prevent the underground and the surface from mixing.

[The world was divided into surface and underground after the death of the Sun God, Kinzelo. Those sent to the underground are what you call demons, and those sent to the surface include humans and other creatures.]
"What's the reason that the two must not mix?"
[Because it's a new order. The Sun God is dead, and the complete world he governed has disappeared.]
A complete world.

The Solaris Cult members Jin had encountered so far believed that the world would be complete again when the Sun God was resurrected. Jin and Hedo kept that in mind as they continued to listen to Ameris's story.

[However, there were those who could not bear the loss brought about by the transition from a complete to an incomplete world. Naturally, they could not accept the new order. Existences beyond birth and death, the damage to the law of causality that resulted from them, the old order that was misaligned the more they tried to restore it. These were the reasons. Those individuals naturally gathered in one place and began to wish for the resurrection of the Sun God.]
"So, that would be the beginning of the Solaris Cult. And your role, Ameris, was to prevent such individuals from finding the underground."
[Yes. But it wasn't all of me that did so. Even among those who were the head of this body, there were those who dreamt of the resurrection of the Sun God.]
Ameris revealed that she originally had nine heads. A large snake with nine heads, a mysterious being common in the mythology of various continents.

[I had to fight those heads. I remember killing one out of five myself, and one was killed by the Myoung Clan. I'm not sure about the remaining three. There hasn't been any activity so far, so they must have either disappeared or are below me, but I don't feel their presence now.]
"What about the other heads that opposed the resurrection of the Sun God..."
[Four heads including me. This body is in front of you, two out of the remaining three were also killed by the Myoung Clan at that time. It would be nice if one head is still somewhere underground.]

From Ameris's perspective, her heads were divided into good and evil. Five wanting the resurrection of the Sun God were evil, and the opposition was good. The heads whose death was unconfirmed were three evil and one good.
[The entities that mortal beings call dragons were formed from the death of my heads. Immortals who were newly born at that time used those fragments to create dragons.]
"Newly born immortals? Wait, so Ameris... you've been in existence longer than the beings we now call gods, haven't you?"
[Name the gods you know.]
As Jin listed all the gods he knew, Ameris shrugged her shoulders.
[The ones other than Solderet and Klam are immortals I don't know. My memory isn't intact, so there might be some among them who know me.]
"We've awakened you from your slumber, haven't we, Ameris..."
[Ho ho, and you did so fearlessly, swinging a weapon at my crown. And to tell you more about Solderet, he is the immortal who taught me swordsmanship.]
Upon hearing that, Jin immediately realized why Ameris's swordsmanship felt strangely familiar.
As the contractor of Solderet, I unconsciously felt his traces. Watching Ameris's swordsmanship.
"Solderet himself taught swordsmanship... Were you close to him?"

[He was an immortal who adapted to the new order of the world. Of course, we would have been very close. When he awakened the joy of a thing called a sword in me, the memory of it being very fun is clear. You said you are his contractor.]
"Yes, I am."
[Perhaps it is not a coincidence but fate that you met me today.]
"I hope so. From the beginning, we and Ameris have the same intentions, and we will have to help each other in the future. But, Ameris."
[Speak.]
"There's a part of your story that's hard to understand. It's about the Myeongwang clan."
[Are you curious about why they killed my heads, who had different hearts?]
"Yes, I am."

[It's a simple story. The Myeongwang people of the time... from your point of view, you can call them the ancient Myeongwang. The ancient Myeongwang people, like all other mortals, were divided into powers. Those who wanted to resurrect the Sun God and those who wanted to stop it.]
"Of course it seems so."

[The ancient Myeongwang people were the only beings who could cross between the surface and the underworld of their own will. Of course, they had to fight me every time, but sometimes I had to avoid the fight. They were mortals who were given too much power.]

Although Ameris didn't explain her power directly, Jin guessed that she must have had a different level of authority in the past. After all, even now, she only had a 'sword fight' with Jin and Hedo, and her true nature has not been revealed.
"Given... So there is someone who gave power to the ancient Myeongwang people?"

[Sun God Kinzelo. The reason why the ancient Myeongwang people were so strong was because the biggest idea of the Sun God was planted in them. Therefore, they were divided into those who wanted to gain greater power by resurrecting the Sun God, and those who accepted the new world.]

This was a secret even the current Myeongwang people in Lafrarosa didn't know. There was a history that was cut off and erased between the ancient Myeongwang people Ameris spoke of and the current Myeongwang people.

[Probably the Myeongwang person who became your brother is the descendant of the latter. If the former had survived until now, the surface would have been ashes already. Mortals who are imbued with the idea of the Sun God naturally tend to destroy the surface. Hedo, there are beings like you who don't fall and withstand temptation.]
"Ameris. Are you saying that the Sun God's idea is planted in me too?"

[Where do you think the strange power you've had since birth came from? If you had grown up wrong, you would have been a great villain whose name would remain in the history of the surface. The idea of the Sun God leads the subject to fall into madness and destroy the surface. To find the underworld, and the altar beyond it.]
